title: Senior Infrastructure & Network Engineer - Germany
description: Your mission Servus und hallo bei uns in Sungrow! Join our Munich IT team and help keep the infrastructure behind Europe’s clean-energy growth secure, reliable, and ready for what comes next. Curious what this is all about? Let’s dive right in: Own the daily operation, maintenance, and continuous improvement of Sungrow Europe’s data center infrastructure, networks, servers, storage, and virtualization platforms. Manage and optimize enterprise network services across European locations, including routing, resilience, performance, capacity, and high-availability design. Take dedicated responsibility for Munich office connectivity, including switches, Wi-Fi, firewalls, VPNs, internet services, and meeting-room networks. Lead technical troubleshooting, incident response, root-cause analysis, and sustainable corrective actions for complex infrastructure issues. Support modernization, expansion, migration, disaster recovery, and technology-refresh initiatives across infrastructure platforms. Strengthen security, compliance, and operational excellence through robust documentation, change management, vulnerability remediation, SOPs, and runbooks. Your profile All right, that was intriguing, wasn’t it? To thrive in this role and enjoy building reliable services for the long term, your background could look like this: You hold a degree in Computer Science, Network Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field, along with at least three years of relevant infrastructure or enterprise network engineering experience. You bring hands-on experience with Fortinet firewalls, SD-WAN, Cisco Firepower FTD, Cisco Nexus 9000, and Cisco enterprise switching environments. You have strong knowledge of routing, switching, and security technologies, including BGP, OSPF, VRF, ACLs, QoS, STP, NAT, link aggregation, and high-availability architectures. You are comfortable operating VMware, Nutanix, and KVM-based virtualization platforms, with knowledge of VMware NSX-T and its security capabilities. You have worked with monitoring and observability tools such as Zabbix, Prometheus, and Grafana, and can use Python, Shell, PowerShell, or Perl for automation. You combine structured problem-solving with a proactive mindset for capacity planning, service improvements, documentation, implementation plans, and rollback procedures. You communicate confidently in English at C1 level; German at B2 level is an advantage, and Mandarin Chinese at B2 level or above is a strong advantage for collaboration with global technical teams. Certifications such as VMware VCP, CCNA or CCNP, Microsoft Azure Administrator, ITIL Foundation, Fortinet NSE, or Nutanix Certified Professional are welcome. Why us? Join a collaborative IT department where your work directly supports Sungrow Europe’s growth and operational resilience. You will have real ownership of a diverse infrastructure landscape, work closely with international technical teams, and contribute to the systems that enable colleagues across Europe to stay connected, productive, and secure. At Sungrow, you will help modernize enterprise infrastructure in a fast-moving greentech environment, while building practical solutions across data centers, networks, cloud platforms, and workplace technology. Du willst Verantwortung übernehmen und Lösungen bauen, die wirklich zählen? Bewirb dich jetzt und gestalte mit uns die Energiewelt von morgen.


Deine Position

Wir suchen einen (Junior) SEO & AI Marketing Manager, der*die mit analytischem Scharfsinn und technologischer Neugier unsere Sichtbarkeit aufs nächste Level hebt. Du verstehst modernes SEO nicht als statische Optimierung, sondern als dynamisches Ökosystem, das du durch automatisierte Workflows und KI aktiv skalierst. Deine Aufgaben umfassen:

  • GEO & AEO (Modern Search): Optimierung unseres Contents für Generative Engine Optimization und Answer Engine Optimization, um in KI-gestützten Suchergebnissen (ChatGPT, Perplexity etc.) maximale Präsenz zu erzielen.

  • Website-Hygiene & Monitoring: Aufsetzen und Überprüfen automatisierter Sanity-Checks und technischer Crawls (z.B. mit Screaming Frog) sowie das direkte Ableiten operativer Maßnahmen.

Agile Schnittstelle: Du übersetzt Kundenbedürfnisse und Business-Ziele in klare Requirements für unser Tech-, Design- und Marketing-Team und stellst die höchste Qualität bei jedem Release sicher. UX/UI & Qualitätssinn: Du hast ein hervorragendes Auge für intuitive Benutzerführung und den Anspruch, nur absolut makellose, kundenfreundliche Web-Anwendungen live zu bringen. AI-First Mindset: Du nutzt KI-Tools ganz selbstverständlich in deinem täglichen Workflow, um Analysen, Specs oder Experimente extrem schnell auf das nächste Level zu heben. Sprachkenntnisse : Deutsch auf muttersprachlichem Niveau und hervorragende Englischkenntnisse. Office-First & Team-Vibes: Du liebst den persönlichen Austausch, schätzt schnelle Kommunikationswege und hast richtig Lust, jeden Tag gemeinsam mit deinem Team in unserem wunderschönen Office im Herzen von Berlin-Mitte zu arbeiten. Gespür für Merchandising, Pricing-Schnittstellen und Margenlogik bei Sets/Bundles. title: Automation Engineer (gn) - 40 Std, (hybrid) (München)
description: Deine Aufgaben Du baust und betreibst unsere n8n-Automationen und verbindest CRM, Customer-Support-Tools, E-Mail und Kalender zu nahtlosen Workflows – von der KI-gestützten Ticket-Klassifizierung über intelligentes Eskalations-Routing bis hin zu automatischen Benachrichtigungen bei kritischen Ereignissen. Du entwickelst Automationslogik und Workflow-Regeln in unserem Support-Tool und sorgst dafür, dass unser Eskalationsmodell technisch sauber abgebildet und Informationen zuverlässig zwischen den Systemen synchronisiert werden. Du integrierst KI-Bausteine dort in unsere Automationen, wo sie echten Zeitgewinn und Mehrwert schaffen. Gleichzeitig denkst du Datenschutz und Datenminimierung von Anfang an mit: Welche Daten an ein Modell übermittelt werden dürfen und welche nicht, ist für dich Teil eines guten Designs. Du baust mit Sicherheits- und Qualitätsbewusstsein statt nach dem Prinzip „ship and pray“: Neue Flows werden zunächst inaktiv getestet , mit realistischen Testfällen geprüft und mit Deduplication-Logik, Fallbacks und Fehlerbehandlung ausgestattet, bevor sie produktiv gehen. Du arbeitest eng mit Operations und Customer Success zusammen, übersetzt operative Pain Points in konkrete, robuste Automationen und kommunizierst proaktiv und transparent , wo ein Flow steht und warum etwas gegebenenfalls länger dauert. Du nutzt KI-Tools wie Claude oder Cursor selbstverständlich als Hebel, um schneller zu bauen, neue Lösungen auszuprobieren und Dinge umzusetzen , die du ohne diese Werkzeuge vielleicht gar nicht entwickelt hättest. Dein Profil Du hast bereits Erfahrung mit Workflow-Automation – idealerweise mit n8n, Zapier oder Make – oder kommst aus der Backend-Entwicklung und bringst einen starken Fokus auf APIs und System-Integrationen mit. (Required) Du bist sicher im Umgang mit REST-APIs und Webhooks , liest und debuggst JSON-Payloads ohne Umwege und findest schnell die Ursache, wenn ein Integrationsflow nicht das tut, was er soll. Erfahrung mit dem Zoho-Ökosystem (CRM, Desk) ist ein großes Plus. Deluge-Scripting ist kein Muss – wichtiger ist deine Bereitschaft, dich schnell und selbstständig einzuarbeiten . Du hast ein gutes Gespür dafür, wie man KI-Bausteine wie Klassifizierung oder Textgenerierung robust in produktive Workflows integriert – und weißt gleichzeitig, wo die Grenzen von Automatisierung liegen und welche Entscheidungen besser beim Menschen bleiben. Du bringst solide Kenntnisse in JavaScript/TypeScript oder Python mit, um bei Bedarf Custom-Code-Nodes zu entwickeln. Du arbeitest strukturiert und sicherheitsbewusst : Du denkst an Testfälle vor der Aktivierung, Fallbacks im Fehlerfall und eine gute Nachvollziehbarkeit , damit auch andere deine Flows später problemlos verstehen und warten können. Du kommunizierst proaktiv und klar – auch dann, wenn etwas länger dauert oder nicht wie geplant läuft. Operations und Customer Success können sich auf dich als verlässlichen Partner verlassen. Du nutzt KI-Tools wie Claude und Cursor gerne als Produktivitäts-Booster, um schneller zu arbeiten, neue Lösungen auszuprobieren und bessere Ergebnisse zu erzielen . title: Product Manager H/F
description:
Product Manager – Innovation & Design

Location: Paris (Hybrid) | Practice Area: Technology & Engineering | Type: Permanent

Imaginez et construisez des produits qui répondent aux vrais besoins des utilisateurs et transforment durablement les services financiers.

 

Capco recherche des Product Managers pour accompagner les acteurs majeurs des services financiers et de l'énergie dans la conception de produits utiles à leurs clients et créateurs de valeur pour leur organisation.

Au sein de notre capability Tech, Product & Engineering, vous intégrerez des équipes pluridisciplinaires réunissant Product Managers, ingénieurs, développeurs et experts métiers.

Votre rôle sera de comprendre les besoins des utilisateurs, identifier les bonnes problématiques à résoudre et transformer ces insights en produits simples, viables et performants.

Vous intégrerez également de manière pragmatique les outils d’IA et d’automatisation approuvés dans vos méthodes de travail pour accélérer la recherche, l’analyse et l’expérimentation, tout en conservant le jugement humain au cœur des décisions produit.

 

Vos responsabilités 

  • Travailler avec des équipes produit pluridisciplinaires pour identifier les problématiques utilisateurs prioritaires et concevoir des solutions à la fois désirables, viables et techniquement réalisables.
  • Intervenir sur l’ensemble du cycle de vie produit, de la discovery et de la recherche utilisateur jusqu’au lancement, à la mesure de la performance et à l’optimisation continue.
  • Combiner études de marché, recherche qualitative, données quantitatives et comportements observés pour construire une compréhension structurée des utilisateurs et exploiter, lorsque pertinent, des outils d’IA approuvés pour accélérer l’analyse et faire émerger des insights.
  • Intégrer les contraintes propres aux services financiers – réglementation, risques et contrôles, protection des données et viabilité économique – dans les décisions produit.
  • Piloter le produit par les résultats et la valeur créée pour les utilisateurs et le business, en testant différentes approches plutôt qu’en vous concentrant uniquement sur la production de livrables.

Compétences et expériences désirées  

  • Au moins 5 ans d’expérience en Product Management, acquise au sein d’une entreprise technologique ou d’un cabinet de conseil.
  • Une expérience avérée dans la discovery, la conception et le développement de produits de bout en bout, idéalement sur des expériences web et mobiles.
  • Une bonne maîtrise des méthodologies produit – Jobs-to-be-Done, personas, frameworks de priorisation, KANO, Lean Startup – et des méthodes de delivery Agile.
  • Une capacité démontrée à collaborer avec des designers, ingénieurs/développeurs, équipes métiers et parties prenantes, ainsi qu’à traiter des problématiques complexes à partir de données et d'insights structurés.
  • Une bonne connaissance de la banque et des services financiers, associée à une curiosité pour les usages de l’IA et des workflows AI-enabled permettant d'améliorer la qualité, la rapidité ou la pertinence du travail produit, dans un cadre responsable et avec validation humaine.
  • Vous êtes à l’aise pour travailler en français et en anglais dans des environnements internationaux. 

 

Pourquoi rejoindre Capco?

Capco est un cabinet de conseil international, spécialisé dans les services financiers.
Fondé en 1998, le cabinet compte aujourd’hui plus de 7 000 collaborateurs dans 36 bureaux à travers le monde, dont 160 à Paris. 

Challenger reconnu face aux grands noms du conseil, Capco se distingue par sa double expertise métier et technologique, au service de la stratégie comme de l’exécution.

Notre promesse : accompagner la transformation de nos clients dans un monde en constante mutation – réglementaire, technologique et opérationnel.

Nous intervenons à l’intersection du business, de la réglementation et de la tech, en mobilisant des équipes pluridisciplinaires, expérimentées et engagées.

 

Nos marqueurs distinctifs :

  • Une spécialisation sectorielle forte
    Nous apportons à nos clients une compréhension approfondie de leurs enjeux métiers, en particulier dans la banque, les marchés de capitaux et l’énergie.
  • Une approche collaborative et sur mesure
    Nous intégrons les équipes clients, adaptons nos méthodes à leur culture et co-construisons des solutions concrètes et opérationnelles.
  • L’excellence comme exigence
    Notre ambition est d’obtenir des résultats mesurables et durables pour nos clients – et de toujours viser la valeur ajoutée.
  • Un esprit “One Capco”
    Nos équipes collaborent à l’échelle internationale pour mobiliser les meilleures expertises et partager les bonnes pratiques.
  • Une culture entrepreneuriale et inclusive
    L’innovation, l’initiative et le mérite sont au cœur de notre modèle. Nous valorisons les idées, la diversité et le progrès collectif.

 

Nos expertises s’articulent autour de 6 métiers complémentaires

  1. Stratégie & Transformation
  2. Finance, Risque & Conformité
  3. Product, Innovation & Design
  4. Data & Analytics
  5. Conseil Tech (Advisory)
  6. Engineering (Delivery)

 

Chez Capco, nous vous offrons :

  • Un environnement de travail international centré sur l’innovation et la création de valeur pour nos clients bancaires et assuranciels
  • Un parcours de formation continu adapté à vos besoins, pour acquérir de nouvelles compétences et développer une réelle expertise
  • Une organisation de travail hybride (charte télétravail de 2 jours par semaine)
  • Une rémunération compétitive avec un bonus lié à la performance
  • Un PEE avec un abondement de 2903€ par an
  • Une culture d’entreprise entrepreneuriale, inclusive et méritocratique, de nouveau certifiée Great Place To Work
  • Des initiatives pour construire le Capco de demain :
    • #BeYourselfAtWork
    • Woman@capco
    • RSE (forfait mobilité durable, jour de solidarité, etc.)
    • Des communautés métiers, sportives et culturelles

 

Chez Capco Paris, handicap visible ou invisible, parcours atypique ou classique, toutes les candidatures sont les bienvenues et seront traitées avec équité.

raw.description:
About Mistral

Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector, co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms.

We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited.

The team

Mistral is building a sovereign AI cloud for Europe. Our customers in finance, healthcare, and the public sector run frontier models on European-jurisdiction infrastructure, and the Cloud Platform team builds the systems that make that possible — compute orchestration, Kubernetes, bare metal, storage, networking, and the datacenter fleet that runs it all.

European Compute Units let enterprises commit to multi-year capacity on that infrastructure, and we are scaling toward a gigawatt of compute across Europe by 2030. You will design and ship the layer every sovereign AI deployment depends on and shape the team building it.

The Role

A datacenter is not a cloud until software makes it one. You will lead the team that turns arriving hardware into accepted clusters.

Cabling validation, burn-in, firmware, deployment validation, software stack install — all of it automated, none of it click-ops. Your KPI is time to acceptance: the hours between a rack being physically installed and it serving customer workloads. Across the industry that number is measured in weeks. You will drive it toward days, then hours, as we scale toward a gigawatt of compute across Europe.

This is a founding leadership role at the intersection of hardware and software. Early on it is deliberately hands-on: most of your time in the code and the architecture, some of it on datacenter floors, because the automation has to survive contact with the machines it runs on.

But the job is building and leading a team from day one — hiring your first engineers, coaching them, setting their growth paths, and running the rituals that keep quality high. As the team grows, the balance shifts toward people leadership, and you decide how fast. You shape this new team's charter and set the standard for how every future Mistral datacenter comes online.

What You Will Do

  • Build the delivery pipeline in Go: provisioning, configuration, validation, burn-in, network bring-up, software stack install.

  • Build the team from scratch: make the first hires, onboard and coach them, own their performance and growth paths — and set the tooling standards and the playbook every future site reuses.

  • Own time-to-acceptance and drive it down relentlessly — measure it, break it down, kill the slowest step first.

  • Work shoulder-to-shoulder with Hardware Design and Fleet Health — reliability starts at delivery.

  • Handle GPU fleets at scale: H100 and GB200-class nodes, InfiniBand and RoCE fabrics, and the failure modes they bring.

  • Partner with Product Managers and the datacenter org to plan delivery waves against capacity commitments.

What We're Looking For

  • You have automated bare-metal fleets — you have written the software that turns racks into clusters. If you have done it by hand, you resented it and scripted it.

  • Hardware fluency: servers, GPUs, NICs, switches, firmware — you can read a parts list and a topology diagram.

  • 8+ years building backend or infrastructure systems, with at least 2 years leading engineers — real people leadership: you have hired, coached, and grown engineers, not just set technical direction.

  • Deep Linux: you are comfortable well below the application layer.

  • You have shipped production systems in Go. Not dabbled. Shipped.

  • Willing to travel to datacenter sites when the work demands it.

  • A low-ego, team-first mindset. We care less about your exact domain and more about whether you are the kind of technical force other engineers want to work alongside.

title: Marketing Campaign Manager
description:
Cordance is dedicated to accelerating the growth of vertically focused business-to-business (B2B) software-as-a-service (SaaS) companies through acquisition and long-term tactical and financial guidance. We’re experienced operators and subject-matter experts with a passion for software and building businesses. We partner with founders to help them scale their businesses and realize their companies’ full potential.

We look for businesses with strong leadership and high potential for profitable growth, and work together to increase year-over-year revenue, company efficiency, and impact. Cordance envisions that all companies we work with achieve their full potential. We embrace what makes each company great and build on those foundations. We believe in elevating a company as it scales, delivering dignity to the organization and its employees, and sharing a passion for building a legacy.

Position Overview 

We are seeking a strategic and results-driven Marketing Campaign Manager to lead the planning, execution, and optimization of integrated marketing campaigns across multiple business units within our Education Division. This role will act as the key liaison between each business unit and our external marketing agency to drive pipeline growth across the division’s portfolio of products and services. 

Key Responsibilities 

Campaign Strategy & Planning 

  • Develop and lead comprehensive, multi-channel marketing campaigns aligned to business unit goals. 
  • Collaborate with business unit stakeholders to understand target audiences, value propositions, and key business priorities to inform marketing campaign strategy and messaging. 

Execution & Project Management 

  • Manage end-to-end campaign execution, partnering with business unit functional teams and our external marketing agency. 
  • Own campaign timelines, deliverables, and budgets, ensuring on-time and high-quality execution. 

Performance & Optimization 

  • Monitor and analyze campaign performance using marketing analytics tools and dashboards. 
  • Continuously test, optimize, and iterate based on data-driven insights to improve conversion rates and pipeline contribution. 

Collaboration & Communication 

  • Partner closely with sales to ensure campaign alignment, support enablement, and accelerate opportunities. 
  • Communicate campaign plans, performance, and insights to key stakeholders across marketing and business leadership. 

Competencies 

  • Strategic Execution: Able to translate business objectives into measurable marketing campaigns. Balances creative concepts with analytical rigor to ensure campaigns ladder up to pipeline, revenue, and brand goals. Demonstrates a strong understanding of audience segmentation and funnel dynamics. 
  • Analytical Decision-Making: Comfortable interpreting campaign data to identify patterns, draw insights, and recommend next steps. Skilled at using experimentation frameworks (A/B, multivariate, incrementality) to validate hypotheses and continuously improve performance. 
  • Operational Excellence: Drives campaigns from ideation through post-mortem with exceptional organization and attention to detail. Anticipates dependencies across channels, timelines, and stakeholders; maintains clear documentation and repeatable processes for scale. 
  • Communication and Collaboration: Communicates campaign goals, insights, and results clearly across marketing, sales, product, and leadership teams. Skilled in vendor and stakeholder management, ensuring alignment on deliverables, expectations, and optimization decisions. 
  • Agility and Growth Mindset: Thrives in dynamic environments. Rapidly adapts to performance trends, feedback, or market changes while maintaining focus on long-term objectives. Demonstrates curiosity and continuous learning in new platforms, tools, and testing methods. 
  • Creative and Brand Stewardship: Shows strong creative judgment and an eye for brand consistency across channels. Partners effectively with content and design teams to ensure messaging and visuals drive engagement while staying true to the company’s identity. 

Qualifications & Experience 

Required Qualifications 

  • 5+ years of experience in B2B SaaS marketing, with at least 2+ years in campaign management. 
  • Experience managing campaigns across multiple business units or products within a division. 
  • Proven success driving integrated campaigns that deliver measurable business outcomes (pipeline, revenue) 
  • Strong project management skills with the ability to manage multiple initiatives simultaneously. 
  • Proficiency in marketing technology platforms such as Salesforce, HubSpot (or Marketo/Eloqua), Google Analytics, and project management tools. 
  • Excellent communication, collaboration, and stakeholder management skills. 
  • Familiarity with segmentation, personalization, and campaign automation best practices.  

Preferred Qualifications 

  • Vertical B2B SaaS experience in education or edtech 

Please note that we do not accept unsolicited resumes, work on a Corp-to-Corp basis, or engage with non-vetted external agencies.

Why Join Us?

At Cordance, we believe in taking care of our team members. When you join us, you’ll enjoy a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your health, financial well-being, and work-life balance:

  • Health and Wellness:
    • Comprehensive Health Coverage: Coverage begins on your first day of employment.
  • Retirement Savings:
    • 401K Plan (US): We match 1:1 for the first 3% of contributions and 0.5:1 for the next 2%. Contribute 5% of your salary and get a 4% match. Choose from pre-tax and Roth options. You’re eligible the first of the month after 90 days and immediately vested.
    • RRSP (CAN): We match 1:1 for the first 3% of contributions and 0.5:1 for the next 2%. Contribute 5% of your salary and get a 4% match. Choose from pre-tax and Roth options. You’re eligible the first of the month after 90 days and immediately vested.
  • Paid Time Off:
    • Flexible PTO: Enjoy uncapped paid time off to balance your work and personal life.
  • Parental Leave:
    • 12 weeks paid leave for all employees.
  • Remote Work Support:
    • Monthly Stipend: Receive $75 USD / $140 CAD per month for phone and internet if you work remotely.
  • Holidays:
    • Generous Holiday Schedule: Benefit from an extensive list of holidays to recharge and spend time with loved ones.

Join us and be part of a company that values your contributions and well-being from day one!

title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer - Care
description:
Our Global Structure


Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we’re unlocking new possibilities as one global team.

Senior Machine Learning Engineer - Care

Join us in our mission to transform the way people shop and eat, where impact, innovation and growth drive everything we do. Our Engineering teams tackle complex technical challenges across a global, three-sided marketplace, building and scaling systems that serve millions of customers, riders and partners every day.

From real-time logistics to resilient infrastructure and marketplace optimisation, we design, build and operate technology that powers Deliveroo’s growth at scale.

We’re looking for a Senior Machine Learning Engineer to join our London team. In this role, you’ll help shape the decision-making systems that directly impact customer experience, trust, and fairness at Deliveroo. This role is based in our London office with a hybrid setup, typically 3 days in the office.

What You’ll Be Doing

You’ll be joining the Care team. Care is an area with significant opportunity and real customer impact; you’ll take ownership of existing models and help define strong ML foundations in spaces that are still evolving, from LLM-powered automation to customer compensation logic.

Here’s what your day-to-day might look like:

  • Own the full ML lifecycle: Lead the design, development, and productionisation of machine learning models used in customer support and high-stakes decision systems.

  • Architect for reliability: Build robust monitoring, evaluation, and alerting frameworks to detect model underperformance, drift, or unexpected behaviour in real-time.

  • Collaborate on product strategy: Partner closely with Product Managers to turn ambiguous customer problems into robust, scalable ML solutions.

  • Drive technical excellence: Provide technical leadership in areas with unclear ownership, setting the gold standard for ML quality, reliability, and maintainability.

  • Bridge science and engineering: Work with data scientists and engineers across the global organisation to embed models into high-performance, scalable systems.

What You’ll Need to Thrive

Essential

  • Significant experience as an ML Engineer or Data Scientist, with a proven ability to write high-quality production code in Python.

  • Demonstrated ownership of productionising Generative AI workstreams or Agentic AI projects, including a deep understanding of LLMs, transformers, and fine-tuning.

  • Proven ability to deploy and manage models using modern infrastructure tools such as Docker, Kubernetes, and CircleCI.

  • Strong foundational knowledge of traditional ML and evaluation techniques, balanced with a bias for simplicity and measurable business impact.

  • A collaborative mindset with experience mentoring peers and a drive to solve complex, real-world problems at scale.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with evaluation harnesses and frameworks specifically designed for Generative AI.

  • Familiarity with observability, monitoring, and safety techniques for deployed GenAI systems.

  • Experience working with strongly typed languages, such as Go.

Why Join Us?

At Deliveroo, you’ll do work that matters—solving real-world problems in a three-sided marketplace that’s constantly evolving. We’re food lovers, problem solvers, community builders and more, brought together by a shared drive to make things better. Working here you can expect to:

🔧 Solve meaningful problems at real scale Work on a complex, always-on marketplace that impacts millions every day.

🌱 See your impact, fast Ship, test and improve ideas quickly in a low-hierarchy, high-ownership environment.

🧠 Grow through challenge and ownership Take on big, ambiguous problems and accelerate your career with strong support.

🌎 A culture built for builders High standards, collaboration, flexible working and continuous learning.

💰 Share in the success you help create Competitive salary and equity options, so you’re rewarded for the impact you make.

➡️ Want a deeper look at how we build? Check out our Tech Blog.

Diversity, Equity and Inclusion

At Deliveroo, we know that a great workplace reflects the world around us and that true diversity and inclusion make us stronger, more creative, and better at what we do. We’re committed to fostering an environment where everyone can do their best work and feel they belong.

We believe in equality of opportunity and welcome candidates from all backgrounds regardless of age, gender, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, socio-economic background, religion, or belief.

If you have a disability or long-term health condition and need support to apply for one of our roles, or require any reasonable adjustments during the recruitment process, you’ll have the opportunity to let us know once you’ve submitted your application. We’ll share details on how to request support so we can ensure you have a fair and equitable experience.

If you’re excited about making a real impact in a fast-moving marketplace and growing your career alongside ambitious, supportive teams, we’d love to hear from you!

title: Senior Content Marketing Manager, Merchant - EMEA
description:
Our Global Structure


Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we’re unlocking new possibilities as one global team.

The role

 

Help merchants get more from their partnership with Wolt and Deliveroo.

 

Reporting to the EMEA B2B Content Team Lead, you will own merchant content programmes across both brands, with a particular focus on helping existing merchants improve their operations, discover opportunities and grow their businesses.

 

You will identify the merchant problems worth addressing, develop the content strategy and lead delivery with colleagues across Marketing, Commercial, Operations and Product. You will also write and edit the content yourself, combining strong editorial judgement with clear ownership of performance.

 

Your core portfolio will include merchant editorial content, customer stories, thought leadership and campaigns that support merchant success. This is a senior individual contributor role with responsibility for setting priorities, leading programmes and demonstrating their impact.

 

What you will own

 

  • Merchant editorial programmes. Build and manage a focused content plan across both brands, including the merchant blog, practical business guidance and thought leadership. Use merchant research, frontline feedback and performance data to decide what deserves investment.

  • Merchant stories and proof. Develop a repeatable case-study programme, from identifying merchants and conducting interviews to securing evidence, approvals and reusable assets.

  • Merchant campaigns. Lead the content strategy and delivery for agreed merchant initiatives, including operational improvements and relevant seasonal occasions. Establish the audience, desired action, content approach, responsibilities and measures before production begins.

  • Content creation and quality. Write and edit compelling content across articles, reports, case studies, email and campaign assets. Brief designers, freelancers and other contributors where needed.

  • Delivery across brands and markets. Coordinate stakeholders, approvals and localisation, adapting content to the needs of each brand and market.

  • Performance and improvement. Set baselines and targets with the relevant teams, monitor results and use them to improve, expand or stop content activity.

 

How you will work

 

You will partner with Growth on website and acquisition content, with GTM on priority launches and with CRM on merchant communications. Those teams own their respective strategies and channel execution; you will own the agreed content programme and its contribution.

 

Within Content, you will collaborate with the owners of merchant education, Ads & Promos, Commerce Platform and social. The Team Lead will continue to lead priority event content during the transition; you may develop stories or campaigns from those events where they support your portfolio.

 

What success looks like

 

You will be accountable for three areas, with targets agreed once baselines and tracking are established:

 

  • Merchant action: the proportion of merchants who take the intended next step after engaging with your content, where tracking allows.

  • Useful engagement: meaningful consumption of priority content, measured through relevant indicators such as engaged reading, completion or repeat engagement.

  • Use of merchant proof: adoption and reuse of case studies and evidence by Commercial and Marketing, with feedback on their effectiveness.

 

You will report what is working, what is not and what you recommend changing. Wider retention and growth outcomes will be shared with the teams responsible for them.

 

What you will bring

 

  • A track record of independently building and improving B2B content programmes, with examples of measurable results.

  • Excellent writing, editing and interviewing skills, supported by a portfolio of substantive work such as case studies, editorial programmes, reports or campaigns.

  • Experience leading campaigns across functions, including setting priorities, resolving competing requests and coordinating delivery.

  • Confidence using analytics and research to make decisions, define success and explain the limits of attribution.

  • Strong commercial judgement and the ability to turn complex product or operational information into useful merchant content.

  • Experience adapting content across markets, working with specialists and managing external contributors.

  • Experience in marketplaces, merchant services, hospitality, retail or B2B technology would be valuable.

 

Why Join Us?

 

At Deliveroo, you’ll do work that matters, solving real-world problems in a three-sided marketplace that’s constantly evolving. We’re food lovers, problem solvers, community builders and more, brought together by a shared drive to make things better. Working here you can expect to:

 

🔧 Make a visible impact every day

Your work directly improves experiences for customers, partners and riders.

🌱 Learn fast in an entrepreneurial environment

Work close to the market with autonomy, pace and real responsibility.

🧠 Build a career, not just a role

Stretch yourself, develop new skills and grow as the business evolves.

🌎 Deliver together in an inclusive culture

Collaborative, values-driven teams that support how you work best.

 

We aim to create a fair process that lets your skills shine—our interview typically includes 3-4 stages. Find more about how we hire here.

 

Our Global Structure

title: Senior Optical Packaging & Assembly Engineer
description:
PsiQuantum’s mission is to build the first useful quantum computers—machines capable of delivering the breakthroughs the field has long promised. Since our founding in 2016, our singular focus has been to build and deploy million-qubit, fault-tolerant quantum systems. 

Quantum computers harness the laws of quantum mechanics to solve problems that even the most advanced supercomputers or AI systems will never reach. Their impact will span energy, pharmaceuticals, finance, agriculture, transportation, materials, and other foundational industries. 

Our architecture and approach is based on silicon photonics. By leveraging the advanced semiconductor manufacturing industry—including partners like GlobalFoundries—we use the same high-volume processes that already produce billions of chips for telecom and consumer electronics. Photonics offers natural advantages for scale: photons don’t feel heat, are immune to electromagnetic interference, and integrate with existing cryogenic cooling and standard fiber-optic infrastructure. 

In 2024, PsiQuantum announced government-funded projects to support the build-out of our first utility-scale quantum computers in Brisbane, Australia, and Chicago, Illinois. These initiatives reflect a growing recognition that quantum computing will be strategically and economically defining—and that now is the time to scale. 

PsiQuantum also develops the algorithms and software needed to make these systems commercially valuable. Our application, software, and industry teams work directly with leading Fortune 500 companies—including Lockheed Martin, Mercedes-Benz, Boehringer Ingelheim, and Mitsubishi Chemical—to prepare quantum solutions for real-world impact. 

Quantum computing is not an extension of classical computing. It represents a fundamental shift—and a path to mastering challenges that cannot be solved any other way. The potential is enormous, and we have a clear path to make it real. 

Come join us. 

Job Summary:

The Senior Optical Packaging Engineer is responsible for developing & implementing high-performance, robust & scalable opto-electronic packaging workflows for a variety of chip-based photonic integrated circuits. This work will be carried out in PsiQuantum’s UK R&D facility located in Daresbury Lab.

Responsibilities:

  • Develop an optical package and fibre-to-chip alignment scheme that allows for high alignment accuracy and scalable assembly.
  • Help develop packaging prototypes & scalable fibre-to-chip packaging flows and processes.
  • Review packaging design BOMs, work with supply chain on procuring parts needed for assembly.
  • Work with our internal packaging team and external vendors on transferring & scaling packaging designs and processes based on successful prototypes.
  • Work with external vendors and suppliers to source required materials and provide feedback on evolving requirements. 
  • Working with external partners to develop advanced opto-electronic packaging solutions.

Experience/Qualifications:

  • Master’s Degree or above in Optical Engineering, Physics or equivalent.
  • 3+ years of experience working on PIC packaging design & qualification.
  • 5+ years of experience working with optical fibers, optical measurements.
  • 3+ years of experience working on FAU / optical connector to chip attachment.
  • Experience with optical data analysis.

description:
Scopely is looking for a Senior Producer to join the Live Game organisation supporting the MONOPOLY GO! team. This role is remote within the EU and will support our Barcelona and Sevilla hubs.

At Scopely, we care deeply about what we do and strive to inspire play every day—through our work alongside talented colleagues and through our connection with millions of players around the world.

MONOPOLY GO! is one of Scopely’s flagship mobile free-to-play franchises and one of the largest games in the mobile industry. 

With teams distributed across Barcelona, Sevilla, the United States, and other global locations, this role requires strong production leadership, excellent communication, and exceptional attention to detail.

About the Role

As a Senior Producer within the Live Game organization, you will oversee development across one or more live game workstreams, helping transform product strategy and creative goals into high-quality player experiences.

You will manage development from early planning and team alignment through implementation, integration, QA, release, and live support. This includes coordinating concurrent initiatives, managing complex dependency chains, driving change request flow, and ensuring teams remain focused on delivering meaningful player and business outcomes.

This is a hands-on, in-the-weeds production role requiring both strategic thinking and tactical execution. You will work closely with Product, Design, Engineering, Art, Content, Economy, QA, Localization, Analytics, Live Operations, and Release Management to deliver at the pace and quality expected of a global mobile live-service game.

What You Will Do

  • Own the end-to-end production lifecycle for assigned Live Game development workstreams, from discovery and planning through development, release, and post-launch support.
  • Manage multiple concurrent initiatives with shared teams, resources, dependencies, and shifting priorities.
  • Translate product strategy and roadmap objectives into clear, executable development plans.
  • Build and maintain integrated schedules, milestone plans, critical paths, risk registers, and dependency maps.
  • Coordinate development across Product, Game Design, Engineering, Art, Content, Economy, QA, Localization, Analytics, Live Operations, and Release Management.
  • Establish clear DRIs, requirements, acceptance criteria, decision points, and delivery expectations for major initiatives.
  • Manage the complete mobile live-service development lifecycle, including design alignment, implementation, configuration, integration, QA validation, release readiness, live activation, and post-launch follow-up.
  • Partner with Live Operations and Release Management to ensure development work is compatible with the LiveOps calendar, release cadence, player priorities, and operational requirements.
  • Lead the change request process by assessing the impact of proposed changes on scope, schedule, capacity, quality, risk, and downstream dependencies.
  • Drive prioritization and decision-making around change requests, communicate approved changes clearly, and ensure plans and systems remain aligned with the latest direction.
  • Proactively identify blockers, bottlenecks, gaps in ownership, and risks to delivery. Resolve issues directly where possible and escalate with clear recommendations when necessary.
  • Facilitate milestone reviews, sprint planning, production checkpoints, risk reviews, and cross-functional working sessions.
  • Ensure meetings result in clear decisions, owners, deadlines, and follow-through.
  • Maintain accurate and current project information across Jira, Airtable, Confluence, and other production systems.
  • Communicate project status, risks, dependencies, decisions, and delivery confidence clearly to both senior leadership and development teams across the Barcelona and Sevilla hubs.
  • Partner with Live Operations after launch to support issue triage, player-impacting investigations, post-launch actions, and continuous improvement.
  • Use player data, team feedback, and operational insights to inform prioritization and improve future development planning.
  • Champion improvements to development workflows, production practices, tooling, and cross-functional collaboration across the Live Game organization.

What We’re Looking For

  • 5+ years of experience in game production, with significant experience in mobile free-to-play or live-service games.
  • Proven experience managing the development and delivery of mobile game features, systems, content, events, or other player-facing experiences.
  • Strong understanding of Live Operations, including high-frequency content delivery, live calendars, release cycles, remote configuration, QA validation, launch readiness, and post-launch support.
  • Experience managing multiple concurrent development workstreams with complex cross-functional dependencies.
  • Strong understanding of roadmap planning, milestone management, critical-path tracking, risk management, change management, and delivery readiness.
  • Experience partnering closely with Engineering and technical teams, with an understanding of client/server dependencies, configuration, integration, and mobile release considerations.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage dependency escalation, negotiate tradeoffs, and create accountability across teams.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to bring clarity to complex or ambiguous situations.
  • Exceptional attention to detail and a strong sense of ownership for the quality and accuracy of production information.
  • Proficiency with tools such as Jira, Airtable, Confluence, Google Workspace, or similar project-management systems.
  • Ability to operate at both strategic and tactical levels, from shaping a development roadmap to following individual deliverables through completion.
  • A player-focused mindset and passion for building engaging, polished, and continuously evolving mobile game experiences.

The Ideal Candidate

  • Is highly organized, structured, dependable, and comfortable operating in a high-volume Live Operations environment.
  • Understands the realities of mobile free-to-play development, including rapid iteration, global releases, frequent content updates, live player impact, and operational precision.
  • Drives outcomes beyond task tracking and status reporting.
  • Anticipates problems before they become delivery issues.
  • Communicates directly, diplomatically, and consistently across global teams and time zones.
  • Creates accountability without unnecessary process or bureaucracy.
  • Is comfortable challenging unclear plans, identifying gaps, and driving decisions.
  • Can manage competing priorities while maintaining focus on the critical path.
  • Brings sound judgment, energy, and a collaborative mindset to a fast-paced, globally distributed development organization.
  • Cares deeply about both the quality of the player experience and the operational excellence required to deliver it.

 

About Scopely

Scopely is a leading video game and global interactive entertainment company, home to many of the world’s most beloved and enduring experiences, including two of the most successful mobile games of all-time “MONOPOLY GO!” and “Pokémon GO,” along with “Stumble Guys,” “Star Trek™ Fleet Command,” “MARVEL Strike Force,” “WWE Champions,” the Scrabble® franchise, “Yahtzee® With Buddies,” and many others. Across mobile, web, PC, and console, Scopely creates, develops, publishes, and live-operates one of the most diversified and award-winning portfolios in the games industry — bringing hundreds of millions of players together through a shared love of play.

Founded in 2011, Scopely is powered by its exceptional team — including thousands of world-class gamemakers around the globe, a distinctive tenet-driven culture, and its proprietary technology platform, Playgami. Together, these strengths have fueled Scopely’s position as the #1 mobile games company in the U.S. and #2 globally, generating more than $10 billion in lifetime revenue. Whether building global sensations like “MONOPOLY GO!” from the ground up, or expanding through strategic acquisitions, including the FoxNext, GSN, and Scopely Explore games businesses — Scopely consistently delivers experiences players love today and return to for years to come.

Recognized multiple times as one of the "100 Most Influential Companies in the World" by TIME magazine and one of Fast Company's "World's Most Innovative Companies" and “Best Workplaces for Innovators,” Scopely believes that video games can be a force for good — creating meaningful connections, vibrant communities, and making life better through play.

Scopely has global operations and partners across four continents in more than a dozen countries worldwide. For more information, visit: https://www.scopely.com/.

description:
The Role

We are looking for a technically-minded individual with a deep personal interest in AI/ML to join the DMFI COO Office as a dedicated AI Strategy Analyst. This is not a traditional quant or engineering role — it sits at the intersection of investment workflows, data strategy, and applied AI, with a mandate to drive real adoption and measurable impact across our Macro & Fixed Income platform.

We need someone who can get hands-on with training, datasets, prompt engineering, and implementation, while continuing to advocate for DMFI priorities with the platform AI team.

The ideal candidate is 3-5 years out of university, likely with a PhD or strong technical background (computer science, data science, computational finance, physics, engineering, or similar), who has a genuine base-case curiosity about AI and can grow into a leadership position as the function scales. We value intellectual horsepower and hunger over years of experience.

What You'll Do

AI Implementation & Hands-On Delivery

  • Own the end-to-end implementation of AI tools and workflows for DMFI PMs and analysts — from scoping use cases through to production deployment and adoption tracking.
  • Build, test, and refine custom prompts, skill libraries, and automated workflows tailored to macro/fixed income investment processes.
  • Develop and maintain custom datasources (vectorised document stores, research embeddings, email ingestion pipelines) that PMs can query via SchonAI/Claude.
  • Work with proprietary pod-level data, market data (Bloomberg, Citi Velocity, DTCC), and internal analytics to create AI-accessible datasets.
  • Prototype and iterate on use cases: AI-driven research briefs, trade write-ups, behavioural bias detection, position analytics, and idea generation tools.

Training & PM Adoption

  • Design and deliver training programmes for PMs and analysts — from prompt engineering fundamentals to advanced Claude Code sessions.
  • Create playbooks, best-practice guides, and reusable templates that lower the barrier to AI adoption.
  • Run regular "AI Lab" sessions, demo new capabilities, and build institutional knowledge across the platform.
  • Track adoption metrics (usage rates, token spend, hours saved, model adoption) and report on ROI to senior management.
  • Identify and address friction points — token budgets, workflow gaps, awareness issues — to drive consistent adoption.

Data Strategy & Dataset Management

  • Map and catalogue DMFI's data landscape: what data exists, where it lives, and how to make it AI-accessible.
  • Drive the ingestion and embedding of key data sources: broker research (email and platform), central bank transcripts, internal research notes, and PM communications.
  • Ensure data quality, naming conventions, and governance standards for all AI-accessible datasets.
  • Work with Technology to build and maintain data pipelines that keep AI tools fed with current, relevant information.

Platform Liaison & Priority Advocacy

  • Act as the primary interface between DMFI and the central AI/Technology team — representing PM priorities, advocating for resources, and ensuring DMFI's roadmap items are appropriately prioritized.
  • Participate in cross-strategy AI working groups, share DMFI use cases, and import best practices from other strategy sets.
  • Translate business requirements into technical specifications that the AI engineering team can deliver.

title: Agentic Systems Engineer (Digital Services)
description:
About us

At Cambridge Consultants, we believe the future of technology isn't just smart, it has agency. We're moving past passive tools and building human-centred digital services and products: systems that reason, plan, and act around the people who use them. Our work spans autonomous systems at the frontier of biology, sensing, and AI.

We hire self-motivated builders, not ticket-takers. If you thrive in highly agile environments, can cut through ambiguity with first-principles thinking, and want to ship things that matter, this is the kind of place where you'll feel at home.

About the role

You'll be working on systems that haven't existed before. Think of an Agentic Coach that navigates the unpredictability of human biology, or the software architecture behind a fully automated Dark Lab. These aren't chatbots waiting for questions. They're proactive systems that maintain world models, interpret human intent, and intervene before the user knows to ask. These systems create genuine impact for clients tackling problems no one else can solve.

Building them means designing and wiring agent harnesses: layered architectures that span from sensor-edge reasoning to high-level planning, backed by stateful multi-turn reasoning, persistent per-user memory, and robust evaluation pipelines.

You'll work in two directions at once. Internally, you'll use the latest AI tools to sharpen how we build, prototype, and ship. Externally, you'll deliver the breakthrough systems our clients deploy, designed to move from prototype to production at pace.

There's no single technology stack. You'll work with agents, multi-agent systems, and the latest generative AI tools, but your work will always be grounded in solid software engineering. Expect to build scalable distributed systems in core languages like Python and TypeScript, leveraging frameworks such as NextJS and Pydantic, agent orchestration tools (LangGraph, CrewAI), and protocols like MCP. You'll deploy on cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, Azure) using Docker, Kubernetes, and infrastructure-as-code, backed by rigorous CI/CD and observability (OpenTelemetry, Prometheus).

Due to the clients we work with, you must be eligible for UK security clearance.

What we ask of you

The examples below describe the core domains our AI Engineers own within the Digital Services team. We don't expect every candidate to have mastered all of these, but if you can demonstrate a strong combination of the following, we'd love to hear from you.

AI System Architecture: Designing and implementing the logic for autonomous systems, including maintaining world models, integrating multimodal sensing, and building real-time human-machine interaction loops.

Infrastructure & Production Engineering: Designing the underlying software for scalable, secure, and observable cloud deployments. You will apply the engineering rigor required to take experimental AI from concept to robust live launch.

Rapid Client Prototyping: Driving a demo-first delivery model. You will focus on fast experimentation to actively show tangible value and working software to clients, rather than describing it in slide decks.

Domain Translation & Integration: Partnering directly with deep-tech subject matter experts (like biologists and roboticists) to apply software solutions to complex physical constraints.

Indicators you'll be a good fit

Applied AI Expertise: You have hands-on experience utilising multi-agent frameworks, long-term memory systems, RAG pipelines, vector/graph databases, and reasoning-loop patterns (such as ReAct and Chain-of-Thought).

Core Software Fluency: You possess strong programming skills in Python and TypeScript, coupled with practical experience in cloud engineering, containerisation, and modern DevOps. You know that great agents still require rock-solid software foundations.

High Tolerance for Ambiguity: You are energised by uncertainty and shifting targets. You treat changing requirements as a normal part of frontier work, and you know exactly when to ship a rough prototype to learn quickly versus when to slow down for architectural rigour.

Cross-Disciplinary Communication: You can seamlessly navigate the gap between code and reality, collaborating with clients, roboticists, and scientists to clearly deliver the "art of the possible."

Benefits

Variety of work: Projects spanning biotech, finance, robotics, and beyond. No two engagements look alike.

Continuous learning: A mentoring and learning package shaped by your goals, backed by squad-based knowledge sharing across the company.

Engineering autonomy: A free hand in choosing the right tools and processes. We trust your engineering judgement.

Access to world-class experts: You'll share a building with biologists, roboticists, electronics engineers, and mathematicians. Few places let you tap that range of expertise on a single project.

Hybrid working environment: We're flexible about where you work on a day-to-day basis. We also love the energy of collaborating in person, so we’d love you to be in Cambridge for key meetings.

Lovable is the counterargument: a platform for all people with ideas, ambition, and problems worth solving. From solopreneurs to small business owners to teams at companies like Adidas and Zendesk, people have built over 60 million projects on Lovable since its launch in November 2024. Comfortable partnering closely with a Growth PM and a Lifecycle team without needing to own their roadmap or tooling. Able to build cross functional trust and alignment without formal authority. Curious about data and results, even if you're not the one running the experiments; you want to know what messaging is working and why. Biased toward shipping and iterating on messaging quickly over lengthy planning cycles. What we’re looking for 6+ years of experience in product marketing, lifecycle marketing, or content/messaging roles. Experience at a high tech company. Direct experience writing messaging and positioning for a PLG or self serve product, ideally across the signup to paid to expansion journey. Familiarity with growth metrics and experimentation frameworks (PQLs, activation rate, feature adoption) enough to speak the same language as a Growth PM. Experience working with developer, startup, or solo builder audiences. Experience building messaging frameworks or toolkits that scaled across multiple teams. What you’ll do Own messaging and positioning strategy for the self serve journey, from signup through activation and expansion. Partner with the Growth PM to translate their roadmap and experimentation priorities into strong, on-brand messaging, bringing your own point of view on framing and positioning rather than just executing briefs. Work hand in hand with the Lifecycle team on new content and messaging for email, in-app surfaces, and push notifications, ensuring everything reflects our positioning and voice. Develop clear point of view documents and messaging guidance for different self serve segments (solo founders, indie hackers, small teams) that inform both lifecycle content and broader growth campaigns. Write and refine copy for high leverage touchpoints: onboarding flows, activation nudges, upgrade prompts, and in-app messaging. Review and sharpen messaging coming out of experiments and campaigns, helping the team understand not just whether something worked, but why, from a messaging and positioning lens. Build a shared messaging toolkit (voice, tone, positioning by segment, proof points) that Lifecycle and Growth can both draw from. Represent the messaging and positioning perspective in growth planning, as a thought partner to the Growth PM rather than an owner of the roadmap itself. Deepgram’s voice-native foundation models are accessed through cloud APIs or as self-hosted and on-premises software, with unmatched accuracy, low latency, and cost efficiency. Backed by a recent Series C led by leading global investors and strategic partners, Deepgram has processed over 50,000 years of audio and transcribed more than 1 trillion words. There is no organization in the world that understands voice better than Deepgram.

Company Operating Rhythm

At Deepgram, we expect an AI-first mindset—AI use and comfort aren’t optional, they’re core to how we operate, innovate, and measure performance.

Every team member who works at Deepgram is expected to actively use and experiment with advanced AI tools, and even build your own into your everyday work. We measure how effectively AI is applied to deliver results, and consistent, creative use of the latest AI capabilities is key to success here. Candidates should be comfortable adopting new models and modes quickly, integrating AI into their workflows, and continuously pushing the boundaries of what these technologies can do.

Additionally, we move at the pace of AI. Change is rapid, and you can expect your day-to-day work to evolve just as quickly. This may not be the right role if you’re not excited to experiment, adapt, think on your feet, and learn constantly, or if you’re seeking something highly prescriptive with a traditional 9-to-5.

Our Customer Success team — The Heartbeat of Deepgram — sits at the intersection of customers, product, and growth. We don't just "manage accounts." We make Deepgram succeed inside our customers' environments by combining deep technical expertise, commercial instinct, and an AI-native way of working — and by building the systems that make the whole team's work compound over time.

Aveni is redefining how financial institutions use AI. We build real, production-ready agentic systems that reshape how banks, advisers and financial services firms operate, replacing fragmented processes with intelligent, end-to-end workflows. We've been recognised as Fintech of the Year for two consecutive years and awarded Best Specialist Technology Service at the Professional Adviser Awards 2025. Backed by leading investors and commercially supported by major financial institutions, we're scaling quickly as adoption of AI in financial services accelerates.

 

Our Wealth platform helps financial advice firms transform how advisers and paraplanners work, using AI to automate documentation, improve compliance and streamline client servicing. From meeting summaries and document generation to compliance file checking and workflow automation, we're helping firms deliver a better experience for both advisers and their clients.

We're looking for a Product Manager – Wealth to lead the evolution of Aveni Assist, our flagship AI-powered platform for financial advice firms.

 

The role

 

This role is responsible for the strategy, roadmap and delivery of Aveni Assist, driving its continued evolution across core adviser workflows including meeting summaries, document generation, Letters of Authority, fact finds and compliance file checking.

 

Unlike an early-stage product, Aveni Assist already has an established customer base and a strong market presence. Your focus will be on scaling the product through continuous improvement—enhancing customer workflows, increasing adoption and satisfaction, and delivering measurable value that drives retention and growth.

 

This is a hands-on, high-ownership product role. You'll work closely with the Head of Product (Wealth) on product strategy while independently leading customer discovery, roadmap prioritisation, delivery and release planning. You'll collaborate with Engineering, Design, Customer Success and Commercial teams to ensure we're solving the right problems and delivering the highest-value outcomes.

 

We're looking for someone who enjoys understanding complex customer needs, making evidence-based decisions and building products that customers genuinely value.

 

What you'll be doing

 

  • You'll own the Aveni Assist roadmap end-to-end, balancing investment between new capabilities, product quality and platform improvements to maximise customer and commercial impact.

  • You'll lead continuous discovery with advisers, paraplanners, compliance teams and prospects, building a deep understanding of customer workflows and translating insight into product decisions.

  • You'll rapidly validate ideas using prototypes, customer research and experimentation, reducing delivery risk before committing engineering effort.

  • You'll own beta programmes for new capabilities, working closely with customers to gather structured feedback and determine when features are ready for general release.

  • You'll partner closely with Engineering and Design to translate strategy into clear delivery plans, maintaining a healthy backlog and ensuring features are released with a high standard of quality.

  • You'll build strong relationships across Engineering, Customer Success, Commercial and Marketing, acting as a trusted voice for the product and ensuring customer insight informs decision-making across the business.

  • You'll use customer feedback, usage analytics and product metrics to guide prioritisation, measure success and continually improve the product.

  • You'll stay informed about industry trends, adviser technology, AI developments and FCA regulation, ensuring Aveni Assist continues to lead the market.

 

What we're looking for

 

  • We're looking for someone with a proven track record as a Product Manager in a B2B SaaS environment, ideally with experience scaling an established product by improving customer satisfaction, adoption and retention.

  • You'll have demonstrable experience leading customer discovery, translating customer insight into product decisions and working closely with Engineering and Design to deliver high-quality software.

  • You'll have excellent product judgement, strong communication skills and the confidence to make difficult prioritisation decisions, balancing customer needs with commercial objectives.

  • You'll be analytically rigorous, comfortable using both qualitative and quantitative data to inform decisions, and capable of building trusted relationships across technical and commercial teams.

  • We're particularly interested in people who are proactive, self-directed and passionate about improving products through continuous iteration and customer feedback.

 

Nice to have

 

  • Experience with AI-powered products or machine learning technologies would be valuable, as would experience within financial services, wealth management or other regulated industries.

  • Knowledge of FCA Consumer Duty, adviser technology platforms or wealth management workflows would be advantageous, but isn't essential.

  • Experience running beta programmes, defining quality standards for AI-generated outputs or contributing to go-to-market activities would also be beneficial.

 

Why join Aveni?

 

You’ll work on genuinely difficult and meaningful problems at the intersection of AI, regulation and financial services.

 

You’ll help shape a product category that is becoming increasingly important as financial institutions move from experimenting with AI to deploying it safely, responsibly and at scale.

 

You’ll have real ownership, visibility and the opportunity to influence both product direction and market positioning at an important stage of Aveni’s growth.

 

Benefits at Aveni

 

What you’ll love:

  • Remote-first working across the UK

  • Company-wide offsites and regular in-person gatherings

  • Work abroad policy

  • Optional Personal Development Plan

  • Flexible benefits platform, so you can choose the benefits that matter most to you

  • Life insurance, income protection, critical illness cover and pension, with up to 5% matched employer contribution

  • Private health and dental care

 

At Aveni, we believe diversity drives innovation. We’ve built our business to ensure an inclusive workplace where everyone feels valued and empowered to contribute their best work.

If you’re passionate about technology and its ability to drive positive change for the future of financial services, we’d love to hear from you. Even if you don’t meet 100% of the requirements, we’d still encourage you to apply if you believe you’d be a great fit.

Aveni is redefining how financial institutions use AI. We build real, production-ready agentic systems that reshape how banks, advisers and financial services firms operate, replacing fragmented processes with intelligent, end-to-end workflows.

 

We have been recognised as Fintech of the Year for two consecutive years and awarded Best Specialist Technology Service at the Professional Adviser Awards 2025. Backed by leading investors including Puma Private Equity, and commercially supported by Lloyds Banking Group and Nationwide Building Society, we previously completed one of Scotland’s largest Series A rounds. Since then, we’ve continued to grow rapidly as adoption of AI in financial services accelerates, and we’re now scaling our engineering organisation to meet that demand.

 

Our engineering team includes experienced software engineers and PhD-level AI specialists, with strong ties to the University of Edinburgh, giving you access to exceptional expertise and opportunities for continuous learning as part of the day-to-day work.

 

The Role

 

As a Senior Software Engineer at Aveni, you’ll be responsible for building and scaling the products that sit on top of FinLLM (the UK's first LLM for the Financial Services industry) and other LLMs, enabling financial institutions to adopt AI safely and effectively.

 

You won’t be expected to build or train the LLMs themselves, instead you’ll be engineering the platforms, services, user interfaces and integrations that bring those models to life in the hands of advisers, analysts and banking teams.

 

Your work will focus on:

 

  • Designing and implementing robust event-driven microservices and APIs

  • Building scalable, cloud-native systems on AWS

  • Developing modern, responsive React front-ends

  • Integrating LLM-powered capabilities into real-world workflows

  • Collaborating closely with product and AI specialists to turn ideas into reliable, customer-ready features

 

What you’ll be working with

 

You should be comfortable with most of our core technologies:

  • Node.js and TypeScript

  • React and modern front-end tooling

  • AWS (e.g., Lambda, ECS/Fargate, API Gateway, SQS/SNS, DynamoDB, RDS)

  • NestJS or equivalent back-end frameworks

  • Microservices and event-driven architectures

 

We also actively embrace AI coding assistants (such as Claude Code) to speed up development, improve code quality and reduce repetitive work — and we encourage engineers to use these tools effectively.

 

What we’re looking for:

 

  • Experience building production systems using Node.js / TypeScript

  • Hands-on experience developing UIs with React

  • Solid understanding of cloud-native engineering on AWS

  • Experience with microservices, messaging patterns and distributed systems

  • A commitment to clean code, testing, observability and operational excellence

  • A proactive and motivated mindset — someone who wants to build, ship and iterate quickly

  • Interest in AI-powered products and a drive to learn

 

Benefits at Aveni

 

What you’ll love

  • Remote-first working across the UK.

  • Work abroad policy for when you want a change of scenery.

  • Co-working spaces available if you want an office buzz sometimes.

  • 34 days holiday (including flexible bank holidays) and your birthday off.

  • Company-wide off-sites (yes, karaoke may happen).

  • Optional Personal Development Plan.

  • Flexible benefits platform: you choose the benefits that matter most to you (not the company).

  • Protection essentials, because we know they matter - Life Insurance, Income protection, critical illness cover, Pension (up to 5% matched employer contribution and optional increased contributions).

  • Private health- and dental care for your peace of mind.

  • Potential share options, have a stake in what you’re building.

  • Enhanced family leave.

 

Join Us in Making a Difference

 

At Aveni, we believe that diversity drives innovation. We've built our business to ensure an inclusive workplace where everyone feels valued and empowered to contribute their best work. If you're passionate about technology and its ability to drive positive change for the future of financial services, we'd love to hear from you.

Even if you don’t meet 100% of requirements, we’d like to hear from you anyway if you believe you’d fit in. Apply now to join us on our mission to transform the financial services industry through AI.

We're looking for a Lead AI Software Engineer to be the most senior technical voice in one of our product squads, working as a technical co-leader alongside the Engineering Manager. You'll own the squad's technical direction and engineering quality end to end, from architectural decision making and hands-on delivery, to mentoring engineers and shaping how we build across the organisation. This role demands genuine depth in AI. You'll be leading LLM powered feature development and setting the standard for how AI tooling amplifies the whole engineering process, combined with the full-stack and cloud-native chops to back it up.

 

What you'll be doing

 

  • Setting technical direction for your squad. Owning architectural decisions, managing technical risk, and representing the engineering perspective at our Architecture Review Board

  • Driving adoption of AI coding tools across the full SDLC, from planning and design through code review, testing, deployment and setting the bar for how the squad works

  • Delivering production grade code across the full stack: Node.js or Python backends, event-driven AWS architecture, and React where the squad needs it

  • Mentoring and growing engineers across AI and full-stack domains, through code reviews, design documents, and day-to-day pairing

  • Collaborating with platform teams to consume shared capabilities and contribute reusable patterns back, not building one-off solutions when a platform component will do

  • Ensuring everything we ship is compliant-by-design, auditable, and built to the standards expected of software in FCA regulated financial services

 

What we're looking for

 

  • A seasoned engineer with 10+ years of experience, including meaningful time building and operating AI systems in production

  • Real technical leadership. You've set direction, made architectural calls, mentored others, and influenced how a team builds, not just what it ships

  • Strong hands-on AI/LLM skills: prompt engineering, RAG, model evaluation and agent frameworks. You know how these work in production, not just in demos

  • Deep expertise in TypeScript and Node.js, with solid experience in React. Experience with Python is beneficial; comfortable switching contexts depending on what the problem needs

  • Cloud-native development on AWS. Serverless, event-driven, Lambda, with an instinct for well designed, maintainable systems

  • A genuine curiosity about where AI is going and the judgment to separate signal from noise when recommending what to adopt

  • An instinct for building responsibly. You care about auditability, compliance, and the downstream impact of what you ship

 

Why Aveni

 

  • You'll work at the frontier of applied AI in a domain where it actually matters, helping financial services firms serve their clients better and meet growing regulatory obligations

  • AI-native engineering culture: we use AI tools seriously, across the full development process, and we're always looking to push further

  • High impact from day one. As a Staff Engineer, your technical decisions will shape the product, the platform, and the engineers around you

  • A talented, collaborative team building something genuinely novel, with the backing, the architecture, and the proprietary models to do it properly

The observation product captures metadata everywhere it is generated and maps it into a knowledge graph, so every run carries full provenance. Orchestration, scheduling, or workflow-engine work, and distributed systems at scale. Data-intensive systems: pipelines, ontologies or knowledge graphs, provenance or lineage. Early-stage or founding-engineer experience at a venture-backed company. Why this is unusual Most software roles like this build a product that lives entirely on a screen.
